## Description

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and why this change belongs in Doom Term.

## Linked issue or scope

Link the issue or state the maintainer-approved scope. Small fixes and documentation changes do not
require upstream Warp readiness labels.

## Verification

List the exact revision, commands, results, and environments. Explain omitted checks and known limits.
For existing evidence, link it and identify its tested revision. Do not present stored results as a
fresh run. Follow the validation order in AGENTS.md; full presubmit is only required when requested.

### Screenshots or recordings

For GUI behavior, attach real application captures. For TUI behavior, include terminal captures or
rendered snapshots. Remove this section for changes where visual evidence is not meaningful.

## Agent context

Name any coding agents used, their scope, the human/maintainer review performed, and remaining
assumptions. Do not paste secrets or private transcripts. See AI_POLICY.md.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and unrelated work is preserved.
- [ ] Product claims distinguish released behavior from changes only on main.
- [ ] Applicable verification and its limits are recorded.
- [ ] Upstream-shared edits are recorded in the invasive-diff ledger.
- [ ] License notices and the local product boundary are preserved.

## Changelog

Use applicable markers below, or CHANGELOG-NONE for internal maintenance. Delete unused entries.
Merging this PR does not authorize release publication.

CHANGELOG-NEW-FEATURE:
CHANGELOG-IMPROVEMENT:
CHANGELOG-BUG-FIX:
CHANGELOG-NONE
